nodes.label: Functional Authorization Boundary
nodes.rationale: Cognito authenticates and API Gateway validates JWTs, while Lambda enforces current role and status from DynamoDB.

nodes.label: Transactional Domain Writes
nodes.rationale: Domain state, uniqueness or authorization projections, and success audit events are committed atomically to prevent partial persistence.

nodes.label: ADR-001 Monorepo
nodes.rationale: Frontend, backend, infrastructure, tests, and documentation evolve as one solution and benefit from coordinated versioning.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Private S3 and CloudFront
nodes.rationale: The static frontend needs secure distribution, so its bucket remains private and CloudFront is the exclusive entry point.

nodes.label: ADR-003 API Gateway HTTP API
nodes.rationale: HTTP API satisfies the MVP with lower complexity, direct Lambda integration, CORS, and JWT authorization.
